historical_archive.authority_limit: Recovered V3/V2/server material is continuity and authority-recovery evidence only; historical V5/DDM has zero authority over current V550+.

owns: explicit provider/model/version binding for V2 rendering
V2 render RNG namespace and seed/sampling identity
no causal-admission inheritance across candidate hashes
does_not_own: generated biography or V3 causal state

direct.use: renderer/bilingual/replay audit consumes model binding, render RNG/sampling identity, hashes and receipts
causal interaction handshake consumes exact candidate artifact identity and no-admission-inheritance law; V3 still owns admission

read_only: V3 admission interface as recipient of exact candidate artifact identity

model_version_law.hosted_model_rule: Pin a provider-published immutable snapshot/revision identifier.
model_version_law.local_model_rule: Pin model artifact digest plus runtime/container digest.
model_version_law.change_rule: Any provider/model/revision/API/runtime binding change requires a new binding_version and new render_request_id.

render_rule_prompt_version_law.change_rule: Any output-affecting prompt, system message, transform, validator, translation rule, render policy, model or version change must be provenance-visible and change render request identity.

lawful_scope: surface-realization-equivalent variation already allowed by a governed expression plan
render_rng_law.render_nonce_rule: V2-only noncausal identity material fixed before provider invocation; never sourced from V3 causal RNG, hidden wall clock, or filesystem order.
render_rng_law.unsupported_seed_rule: Rendering may proceed when lack of seed control is explicit in the pinned binding; provider regeneration is then UNGUARANTEED and exact replay uses the stored artifact.

retry_rerender_identity_law.retry: Lawful only after operational/provider failure with no usable model output. Preserve render_request_id and all semantic/model/prompt/sampling/seed/constraint identity, increment retry_ordinal, create a new provider_attempt_id.
retry_rerender_identity_law.ambiguous_timeout: Record UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_COMPLETION. No candidate exists unless output later arrives and is captured; late output is separately hashed and cannot overwrite another candidate.
retry_rerender_identity_law.rerender: Any new model invocation after output was received, or any invocation changing provider/model/prompt/sampling/seed/constraints/surface-variation request. Increment rerender_ordinal, use new render_nonce and render_request_id, and create a new candidate identity.
retry_rerender_identity_law.identical_visible_text_rule: rendered_content_hash may match across rerenders, but candidate_artifact_hash and candidate_id MUST differ because provenance differs.

hash_profile.text_canonicalization: Exact application-received Unicode encoded as UTF-8; no Unicode, whitespace, newline or case normalization before hashing.

artifact_receipt_law.attempt_artifact: Every provider invocation records an immutable V2RenderAttemptArtifact with request/attempt IDs, provider response metadata, operational status, and raw_output_hash when output exists.
artifact_receipt_law.candidate_artifact: Only output passing governed truth/expression constraints may finalize as immutable RenderedTurnArtifact.

replay_audit_law.artifact_replay: Retrieve immutable candidate by candidate_artifact_hash and verify content/artifact/receipt hashes; MUST NOT call a model.
replay_audit_law.process_reexecution: Optional diagnostic execution using exact pinned identity; always a new audit execution and never overwrites the original. Different output is REEXECUTION_MISMATCH.
replay_audit_law.causal_replay: V3 causal replay does not regenerate V2 text. It replays admitted causal events plus the exact admitted candidate artifact hash/admission receipt.

causal_admission_separation_law.in_world_causal_rule: A valid RenderedTurnArtifact remains CANDIDATE_NONCAUSAL_PENDING_V3_ADMISSION until a separate V3 receipt admits that exact candidate_artifact_hash.
only_exact_admission_may_authorize: commit/expose the artifact as an in-world utterance/action that actually occurred

forbidden_behavior: provider inference from model name or credentials
using V3 causal RNG for V2 rendering
render RNG choosing semantic or causal facts
model output inventing hidden facts or filling missing authority
rendered language serving as evidence of V3 state
editing a candidate artifact in place
inheriting causal admission across candidate hashes
causal publication before exact V3 admission
